summary: Completed comprehensive testing of newly added features (admin portal, embedded maps, partner logos, accurate route map) plus regression testing of existing contact flow. All backend APIs (12/12) and frontend features tested successfully with 100% pass rate.

Backend POST /api/admin/login with valid token 'gsf-admin-2026' returns {ok:true}
Backend POST /api/admin/login with wrong token returns 401
Backend POST /api/admin/login without token returns 401
Backend GET /api/contact with valid token returns 200 with list of 4 contacts sorted by most recent first
Backend GET /api/contact with wrong token returns 401
Backend GET /api/contact without token returns 401
Backend POST /api/contact with valid payload stores record and returns {ok:true, id, email_status:sent}
Backend POST /api/contact validation: missing name returns 422
Backend POST /api/contact validation: missing company returns 422
Backend POST /api/contact validation: missing message returns 422
Backend POST /api/contact validation: invalid email returns 422
Frontend home hero route map (hero-route-map) renders with route path (hero-route-path)
Frontend home partner logo grid displays 4 partner logos loaded from /partners/*.svg: tesa (120px), ecograph (220px), isra-vision (200px), just-normlicht (120px)
Frontend /standorte Cape Town card (index 0) has embedded Google Maps iframe (location-map-0) and directions link (location-directions-0)
Frontend /standorte Durban card (index 1) has embedded Google Maps iframe (location-map-1) and directions link (location-directions-1)
